boundaries.name: identity_boundary
boundaries.definition: EOA identity must not be treated as proof of non-programmable behavior.
boundaries.eip7702_mechanism: SET_CODE_TX (type 0x04) assigns delegation designator to EOA without changing its address, balance, or nonce — breaking the assumption that address type determines behavior.
boundaries.pre_7702_assumption: If tx.origin == msg.sender, the caller is a plain EOA with no executable code.
boundaries.post_7702_reality: A delegated EOA retains its address and tx.origin identity while executing arbitrary contract code.
boundaries.impact: Authentication bypass, privilege escalation, access control failure

boundaries.name: code_boundary
boundaries.definition: Code-presence checks must not be the only boundary between EOAs and contracts.
boundaries.eip7702_mechanism: Delegation designator (0xef0100 || address) makes EOA code-bearing but via indirection — extcodesize may return delegation prefix length, not actual code.
boundaries.pre_7702_assumption: address.code.length == 0 or !isContract(addr) means the address has no executable logic.
boundaries.post_7702_reality: Delegated EOA has code (delegation designator), and code-length checks may pass or fail unpredictably depending on client implementation.
boundaries.impact: Contract-only logic bypassed by delegated EOA, or delegation target destruction breaking account liveness

boundaries.name: storage_boundary
boundaries.definition: Delegated code must not assume isolated or contract-owned storage layout.
boundaries.eip7702_mechanism: Delegated code executes in the EOA's storage context — same address, same slots. Multiple delegation targets may share or collide on storage slots.
boundaries.pre_7702_assumption: A contract's storage is its own — no other code can read/write slots unless via delegatecall.
boundaries.post_7702_reality: Delegation target code reads/writes the EOA's storage, and redelegation to a different target creates slot collision risk.
boundaries.impact: State corruption, initialization race, proxy/delegation storage collision, ownership hijack

boundaries.name: call_boundary
boundaries.definition: Calls, callbacks, hooks, and delegatecalls must preserve expected trust boundaries.
boundaries.eip7702_mechanism: ETH transfers and token operations to a delegated EOA can trigger fallback/receive or token hooks — the EOA now has code that executes on incoming calls.
boundaries.pre_7702_assumption: Sending ETH to an EOA has no side effects. EOAs cannot execute token hooks (onERC721Received, tokensReceived, etc.).
boundaries.post_7702_reality: A delegated EOA can have receive()/fallback(), implement hook interfaces, and reenter during transfers.
boundaries.impact: Reentrancy, delegatecall context escape, unexpected side effects on value transfer, token hook exploitation

boundaries.name: validation_boundary
boundaries.definition: Authorization, signature, nonce, and EntryPoint validation must bind to delegated account semantics.
boundaries.eip7702_mechanism: EIP-7702 changes signer model — ecrecover still works on EOA but delegation may add contract-style validation (EIP-1271). EntryPoint version and validation constraints also shift.
boundaries.pre_7702_assumption: ecrecover(hash, v, r, s) == signer is sufficient for EOA authentication. EntryPoint version is stable.
boundaries.post_7702_reality: Delegated accounts may require EIP-1271 isValidSignature, newer EntryPoint versions, or different validation semantics.
boundaries.impact: Signature validation bypass, permit exploitation, EntryPoint incompatibility, validation environment dependency

boundaries.name: replay_boundary
boundaries.definition: Delegation authorizations must be bound to chain, nonce, ordering, and domain context.
boundaries.eip7702_mechanism: Authorization tuples in SET_CODE_TX include chain_id and nonce but applications may fail to enforce these or may allow batch replay across operations.
boundaries.pre_7702_assumption: Transaction nonce prevents replay. Chain ID binding prevents cross-chain replay.
boundaries.post_7702_reality: chain_id=0 authorizations replay on any chain. Delegation nonce and tx nonce are separate. Batch operations may reorder or replay authorizations.
boundaries.impact: Cross-chain replay, nonce gap exploitation, batch authorization replay, delegation reuse

boundaries.name: revocation_boundary
boundaries.definition: Delegation must have an auditable revocation and liveness path.
boundaries.eip7702_mechanism: Delegation is revoked by setting code to address(0) via another SET_CODE_TX. But if the contract has no revocation interface, or relies on a single relayer, revocation may be impossible.
boundaries.pre_7702_assumption: Contract code is immutable once deployed (barring proxy upgrades with admin key).
boundaries.post_7702_reality: Delegation can be changed or revoked per-transaction, but missing revocation paths create permanent exposure.
boundaries.impact: Irrevocable delegation, single relayer capture, permanent authority over EOA

boundaries.name: gas_boundary
boundaries.definition: Sponsored or delegated execution must bound gas use and griefing impact.
boundaries.eip7702_mechanism: EIP-7702 enables sponsored execution where a third party pays gas for the delegated account. Without gas limits, the delegated code can consume unbounded sponsor gas.
boundaries.pre_7702_assumption: Gas sponsorship is bounded by explicit gaslimit in the transaction.
boundaries.post_7702_reality: Delegated code can consume sponsor gas in validation phase (ERC-7562 violation) or execution phase without bounding.
boundaries.impact: Gas griefing, sponsor fund draining, bundler DoS, underaccounted pre-verification gas

checks.title: tx.origin == msg.sender EOA identity assumption bypass
checks.pattern: require(tx.origin == msg.sender) as EOA-only access control
checks.pre_7702_assumption: tx.origin == msg.sender guarantees caller is a plain EOA
checks.post_7702_reality: Delegated EOA passes this check while executing arbitrary code
checks.detection_method: Regex match on tx.origin == msg.sender in require/if

checks.title: isContract()/extcodesize code-presence check bypass
checks.pattern: address.code.length == 0 or isContract() as behavior gate
checks.pre_7702_assumption: No code means no executable logic at that address
checks.post_7702_reality: Delegation designator makes EOA code-bearing
checks.detection_method: Regex match on extcodesize/code.length/isContract

checks.title: Callback reentrancy via delegated EOA
checks.pattern: ETH transfer to EOA followed by state update without reentrancy guard
checks.pre_7702_assumption: ETH transfer to EOA cannot trigger callback code
checks.post_7702_reality: Delegated EOA can have receive()/fallback() that reenters
checks.detection_method: Pattern: .transfer()/.call() to EOA-typed address + state change after

checks.title: Cross-chain delegation replay (missing chain_id binding)
checks.pattern: Authorization tuple without chain_id validation
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Delegation authorization is bound to the intended chain
checks.post_7702_reality: chain_id=0 or missing chain binding replays on any EVM chain
checks.detection_method: Pattern: delegation/authorization without chainId/chain_id/block.chainid

checks.title: Missing delegation revocation mechanism
checks.pattern: Delegation target without setCode(address(0)) or revoke path
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Delegated authority can be safely disabled after assignment
checks.post_7702_reality: No revocation path means permanent delegation exposure
checks.detection_method: Pattern: delegation-aware contract without revoke/undelegate/setCode(0)

checks.title: Delegatecall context escape in delegation target
checks.pattern: delegatecall to external address in delegation-aware contract
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Delegation target execution stays inside intended account logic
checks.post_7702_reality: delegatecall from delegation target can swap execution context
checks.detection_method: Pattern: delegatecall in contract with delegation markers

checks.title: Storage slot collision between delegation target and EOA
checks.pattern: owner/admin at slot 0 in delegation target without namespace
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Contract storage is isolated from other code at same address
checks.post_7702_reality: Multiple delegation targets share the EOA's storage slots
checks.detection_method: Pattern: state variables (owner, admin) at slot 0 without ERC-7201

checks.title: Initialization race in delegated account
checks.pattern: initialize/setUp without initializer modifier or initialized flag
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Account initialization is atomic and cannot be front-run
checks.post_7702_reality: Delegated account can execute before owner/guard state is initialized
checks.detection_method: Pattern: initialize() without initializer/initialized guard

checks.title: ERC-1967 proxy pattern conflict with EIP-7702 delegation
checks.pattern: ERC-1967 proxy slots in delegation target contract
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Proxy storage layout and contract storage cannot conflict
checks.post_7702_reality: ERC-1967 slots can collide with delegation target assumptions
checks.detection_method: Pattern: ERC-1967 slot constants + delegation markers in same contract

checks.title: ERC-20 permit() vulnerable to delegated EOA abuse
checks.pattern: permit() with ecrecover without EIP-1271 fallback
checks.pre_7702_assumption: ecrecover validates a normal EOA signer model
checks.post_7702_reality: Delegated EOAs may change signer semantics without EIP-1271
checks.detection_method: Pattern: permit function + ecrecover without isValidSignature

checks.title: Batch authorization processing without nonce validation
checks.pattern: Batch/multicall processing authorization tuples without sequential nonce
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Batched operations execute in validated order exactly once
checks.post_7702_reality: Batch authorizations can be reordered or replayed
checks.detection_method: Pattern: batch/multicall + authorization without nonce increment

checks.title: Meta-transaction nonce gap with EIP-7702 delegation nonce
checks.pattern: Separate nonce tracking for meta-tx and delegation
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Transaction nonce and delegation nonce advance together
checks.post_7702_reality: Separate nonce domains can leave replayable gaps
checks.detection_method: Pattern: meta-tx nonce tracking without delegation nonce binding

checks.title: Gas sponsorship griefing in delegated execution
checks.pattern: Sponsored/relayed execution without gas limit specification
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Sponsored execution has bounded gas exposure
checks.post_7702_reality: Delegated code can consume unbounded sponsor gas
checks.detection_method: Pattern: relay/execute/sponsor without gaslimit/gasLeft check

checks.title: Value transfer to delegated EOA triggers unexpected code
checks.pattern: ETH send to EOA address without considering delegation
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Sending ETH to an EOA has no programmable side effects
checks.post_7702_reality: Value transfer to delegated EOA triggers code and callbacks
checks.detection_method: Pattern: .transfer()/.send()/.call{value:} to address typed as EOA

checks.title: Delegation target with selfdestruct breaks account liveness
checks.pattern: selfdestruct in delegation target contract
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Delegation target code remains available and safe
checks.post_7702_reality: selfdestruct in target breaks all delegated accounts pointing to it
checks.detection_method: Pattern: selfdestruct/SELFDESTRUCT in delegation-aware contract

checks.title: ecrecover-only auth without EIP-1271 contract signature support
checks.pattern: Auth using only ecrecover without isValidSignature fallback
checks.pre_7702_assumption: ecrecover is sufficient for EOA signature validation
checks.post_7702_reality: Delegated accounts may require contract-style validation
checks.detection_method: Pattern: ecrecover in auth path without EIP-1271 isValidSignature

checks.title: ERC-777 token hook exploitation on delegated EOA
checks.pattern: Token transfer to EOA that could be delegated with tokensReceived
checks.pre_7702_assumption: EOA token recipients cannot execute hook code
checks.post_7702_reality: Delegated EOAs can implement tokensReceived and reenter
checks.detection_method: Pattern: ERC-777 transfer to address without reentrancy guard

checks.title: approve() frontrun amplified by EIP-7702 delegation
checks.pattern: approve without increaseAllowance in delegation context
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Approval race is mitigated by EOA not having execution logic
checks.post_7702_reality: Delegated EOA can atomically front-run approval changes
checks.detection_method: Pattern: approve() without increaseAllowance + delegation context

checks.title: Single hardcoded relayer creates delegation liveness risk
checks.pattern: require(msg.sender == RELAYER) without fallback
checks.pre_7702_assumption: A single relayer remains trusted and live for delegated execution
checks.post_7702_reality: Relayer failure captures delegated account permanently
checks.detection_method: Pattern: single relayer address comparison without alternative

checks.title: Raw storage without ERC-7201 namespace in delegation target
checks.pattern: State at slot 0 without keccak256(eip7201:) namespace
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Delegation target state slots remain stable across redelegation
checks.post_7702_reality: Missing namespacing corrupts state across delegation targets
checks.detection_method: Pattern: storage variables without ERC-7201 namespaced storage

checks.title: Hardcoded EntryPoint v0.6 incompatible with v0.7+
checks.pattern: Hardcoded 0x5FF137D4 (v0.6) without version check
checks.pre_7702_assumption: A hardcoded EntryPoint version validates all AA flows
checks.post_7702_reality: Delegated accounts may depend on newer EntryPoint semantics
checks.detection_method: Pattern: hardcoded EntryPoint v0.6 address constant

checks.title: Validation function reads forbidden environment data
checks.pattern: block.timestamp, tx.origin, gasleft in validate* function
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Validation outcome is deterministic across bundler simulation and inclusion
checks.post_7702_reality: Environment-dependent validation can pass simulation but fail on-chain
checks.detection_method: Regex match on block.*/tx.origin/gasleft/selfdestruct in validate* functions

checks.title: Validation function performs value transfer
checks.pattern: .call{value:}/.transfer()/.send() inside validation
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Validation only proves authorization, cannot move value
checks.post_7702_reality: Value transfer during validation creates unbounded gas and state risk
checks.detection_method: Pattern: value-bearing call inside validateUserOp/validatePaymasterUserOp

checks.title: Validation depends on mutable external code identity
checks.pattern: extcodehash/extcodesize of external address in validation
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Code observed during simulation is identical during inclusion
checks.post_7702_reality: EIP-7702 can change code between simulation and execution
checks.detection_method: Pattern: extcodehash/extcodesize in validate* function

checks.title: UserOperation accepts multiple EIP-7702 authorization tuples
checks.pattern: Batch authorization acceptance without dedup/binding
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Each UserOp has at most one authorization tuple
checks.post_7702_reality: Multiple authorization tuples can be replayed or reordered
checks.detection_method: Pattern: authorization tuple handling without count/dedup check

checks.title: Delegated EIP-7702 account used outside UserOperation sender
checks.pattern: EIP-7702 account interacting as non-sender entity
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Delegated accounts only act as UserOp sender
checks.post_7702_reality: Delegated EOA can act as paymaster, aggregator, or factory
checks.detection_method: Pattern: delegation-aware contract acting as paymaster/aggregator

checks.title: Batch accepts same-sender EIP-7702 authorizations without consistency
checks.pattern: Same sender in batch without delegation consistency check
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Batch operations from same sender are consistent
checks.post_7702_reality: Same sender may have different delegation state per operation
checks.detection_method: Pattern: batch processing same sender without delegate address check

checks.title: Signature validation does not bind to userOpHash
checks.pattern: Signature validation without userOpHash in signed data
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Signature validates the specific UserOperation
checks.post_7702_reality: Without userOpHash binding, signatures can be replayed across operations
checks.detection_method: Pattern: ecrecover/isValidSignature without userOpHash parameter

checks.title: Validation function is not gated to EntryPoint caller
checks.pattern: validateUserOp without require(msg.sender == entryPoint)
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Only EntryPoint calls validation functions
checks.post_7702_reality: Without gate, anyone can call validateUserOp and extract state
checks.detection_method: Pattern: validateUserOp without msg.sender == entryPoint check

checks.title: EIP-7702 authorization gas cost not included in pre-verification gas
checks.pattern: preVerificationGas calculation without PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST
checks.pre_7702_assumption: Standard gas estimation covers UserOperation costs
checks.post_7702_reality: EIP-7702 adds PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST that must be budgeted
checks.detection_method: Pattern: preVerificationGas without EIP-7702 gas cost consideration
